tribal_context: Eastern Band of Cherokee Indians — major sovereignty infrastructure in western NC. Qualla Boundary (56,000+ acres). Harrah's Cherokee Casino revenue funds comprehensive services. ICWA mandatory for enrolled members.

tribal_entities.services: Tribal TANF, housing, health, education, elder services, child welfare
tribal_entities.land: Qualla Boundary — 56,000+ acres in Great Smoky Mountains
tribal_entities.note: Distinct political and cultural identity from Cherokee Nation of Oklahoma. Programs available to enrolled members outside Qualla Boundary with enrollment documentation.
